import numpy as np
def equation(t, A, params):
    p = params
    a0 = p[0] + p[1]/t
    b = p[2] + p[3]*t + p[4]*t**2
    K = np.abs(p[5] + p[6]*t) + 1e-9
    n = p[7]
    An = np.abs(A)**n
    return a0 + b*An/(K**n + An) + p[8]*A*np.exp(-p[9]*A)
